tickets.title: Main can hud_read an unreadable-QA handback job; notices skip timed-out questions
tickets.what: Milestone review j57643d748cab8a7b findings 1 (major) and 2 (minor). The same receipt aborts the project list (`operations.ts:127,152`), so healthy jobs are hidden too. `docs/spec.md:52-53`: a notice is not a read; `hud_read` returns the digest or report. Fix: observational reads (job read/digest/full report, the project list, wait sampling and the post-Git reread) use unknown question evidence (`open_questions: null`) on a QA read failure instead of throwing. Land admission and the flake auto-land block stay strict: never treat unreadable QA as empty, never publish. (2) After ask → report → Pi timeout, a watcher started on the same pane while the receipt is retained emits `QUESTION q1 … reply: hud_respond` on catch-up, because `jobRow` (`src/collectors/thin-jobs.ts:330-335`) copies `readQa().openIds` without the recorded `timed_out_questions` filter that auto-land (`src/mcp/land-flakes.ts:815-816`) and Execution (`src/collectors/execution.ts:345-350`) apply. Share one small successful-read filter (drop IDs in the receipt's `timed_out_questions`) and use it for the question IDs that notices use. Keep unknown on a read failure and keep every other unanswered ID. Do not add new state or a retry mechanism. Callers keep their own decisions about unknown evidence.
